Definition: Whether the instant payment system enables or plans to enable instant payments across national borders to other countries or regional payment systems, supporting remittances, trade, and regional integration.
Comments: Cross-border functionality exists via at least one mobile money provider: QMoney launched a cross-border transfer service enabling instant transfers between Sierra Leone and The Gambia (mobile-to-mobile), and PAPSS documentation lists Gambia as a live country on the system for intra-African payments (through participating banks).

Definition: Whether and how the central bank participates in payment system governance beyond its regulatory oversight role, including board representation, operational management, technical standard-setting, or direct system operation.
Comments: The Central Bank of The Gambia (CBG) provided regulatory leadership and oversight for BANTABA 2.0, and Gamswitch (the national payment switch) that operates the platform was established by CBG as a vehicle for retail electronic payment development.
